title: FBI-UAP-D015, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-2, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration) of a reported UAP incident, not a primary evidence photograph or report.
interpretation_warnings: This is an artist's rendering, not a photograph or sensor capture — its visual details reflect an illustrator's interpretation, not direct evidence.
No source text could be extracted from the file; all facts here derive from the war.gov CSV metadata only, not from the image itself.
The underlying account is single-source: one federal law enforcement special agent's first-hand description (documented in DOW-UAP-D079).
The rendering was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the reported October 2023 event, introducing potential recall and reconstruction bias.
The specific site is described only as a 'sensitive national security site' and is not named, so the exact location cannot be independently verified.
